title: Unit Event — A Sad Farewell at the Curtain Call

meta.Event: A Sad Farewell at the Curtain Call
meta.Outline: The next ambassadorial performance is going to be the last one?! Wonderlands×Showtime is staggered to hear the news, but is followed by an offer to do a joint performance with a highly regarded theme park that puts on the best shows in Japan. As chaotic practices ensue, Rui is approached by a certain person...

rows.Line: Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, it's complete.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hehe. We'll be able to use this miniature lighting mechanism to do projection mapping wherever we like, which should allow us to employ a wide variety of new effects.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm looking forward to seeing how everyone reacts when they see this.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Ah, if only it could be tomorrow now. Then I'd be able to show them immediately.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I have them to thank for being able to try putting on so many different kinds of shows.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If we can keep putting on shows like this for as long as possible...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yes, we probably will have to go our separate ways in order to pursue our dreams...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The thought of that happening is really sad and makes my heart sink...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But when that happens...
I have a feeling that it'll be the moment when we take a big step towards achieving our goals...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And until that time comes, I want to cherish the shows that we're able to do together...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: All of us... Together!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Until that time comes, eh...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
She's right though.
We'll have to cross that bridge eventually.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, until then, I should keep doing my absolute best.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, I should go to bed soon. They'll surely scold me if I show up with bags under my eyes...
The next day
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Soon... No, not yet... But they should be...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're done cleaning over here!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Good job, you two.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hm...?
What's Tsukasa doing over there? He seems kinda anxious.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, he does. He seemed fine just a second ago...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, it may be because Emu's brothers are supposed to meet with us soon...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
They usually tell us where we're going to do our ambassadorial performances in the morning on days off.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I can't wait to hear about where we're going next♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm... They should be here soon...
But they're later than usual...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Good morning.
You all seem well, as usual.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, there you are!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Whoa!
What's going on? There's no need to run...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've been eagerly waiting to hear about where we'll be doing our next ambassadorial performance! Our show for Shibuya Festa went beyond splendidly, so I'm looking forward to producing similar results!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Ah, I see...
Well...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hm?
Is something wrong, Shosuke?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Um, so...
Shouldn't we tell them already, Keisuke...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Yes.
It'll make things easier to explain if we start with that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Your next ambassadorial performance will be your last.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wh-What do you mean?!
This is so sudden! Why?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! Why?!
Everyone loves our shows and they always smile after seeing them! What's going on here?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mind if we ask for more details regarding this?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
First...
It will be your last, but that is not actually a bad thing.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Remember what our initial objective was... To attract guests from other parts of the country who don't normally get a chance to visit our park.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I do remember you guys mentioning how this park is easy to access for the locals but not for people who live far away...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Precisely.
Our main goal was to attract guests from the more far-flung regions of the country...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: However, we ended up accomplishing that goal much quicker than we initially expected. As a result, we've seen a high influx of those guests.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So, our shows really worked...?!
Woohoo! Awesome!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, which is why we won't be doing any more shows!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: At the same time...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If they were so effective, why not keep doing them...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Point taken, but as it so happens, quite a few of our guests visit Phoenix Wonderland to specifically see your shows. More than you might expect.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. Now I'm starting to understand...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're visiting the park to see us perform, so not being here because of our ambassadorial duties would only serve to disappoint them...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Yes, exactly.
As such, we need you to stay and perform at the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Then, both the park and its guests will benefit.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Right...
I guess that makes sense if they want to see us that much...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, we should be grateful.
Still...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We learned so much from doing these performances. In that sense, this is rather unfortunate news...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...
You, Nene and Rui smiled so much... And I learned a lot...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I'm also happy that so many people from all over the country are coming to visit!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, these ambassadorial performances were definitely worth the effort, since we needed to come up with so many creative solutions for them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I agree...!
And we'll do the same for everyone who comes to see us at the Wonder Stage by putting on magnificent shows for them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But first, we'll need to cap off our ambassadorial performances with a big finale!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!!
Let's do our best to make that happen!!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We actually have a suggestion regarding your final ambassadorial performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A suggestion?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Yes.
This may feel a bit sudden, but...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: How would you all like to do a show with the cast of ArcLand...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? ArcLand...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As in Tokyo ArcLand?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What?! The ArcLand...?!
The park that's famous for putting on world-class shows and performances...?!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, the very same. Not unlike Riley Dream Park, they operate parks in ten countries around the world that are based on the countless movies they've produced.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's a very attractive offer, but how did this come to be exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Not too long ago, some people from ArcLand contacted us about our show casts doing a performance together as a sort of cultural exchange meant to help raise each other's skills.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A cultural exchange?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We wondered why they were asking us this at all initially, and believed that they were trying to undermine us somehow after we finalized our partnership with Riley Dream Park...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: However, as it turns out, they genuinely seem to want to use this opportunity to give their cast members a chance to improve their skills.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really? Even though they're already this popular...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Despite being the best show in town, they're not resting on their laurels. That's very admirable of them...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: They even mentioned you specifically and how it'd be an honor to work with the peerless casts of the Wonder Stage and Phoenix Stage since they're all the rage right now.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We're thinking about having Seiryuin and her troupe guide them around the park, with you all doing a show with them. How does that sound...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (ArcLand is the theme park that arguably puts on the best shows in the country.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They've even put on shows recently with casts consisting of some of the best young actors around and directors from around the world. They're clearly not afraid to take on new challenges.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We stand to learn a lot from them. This could be an opportunity for us to grow quite a bit as a troupe.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And I'm personally curious...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'd like to go forward with this.
What do you all think?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm for it too!
If lots and lots of people come to see our show, it's gonna be even more wonderhoy than usual!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I might start feeling nervous if too many people show up... At the same time, I could learn a lot from this experience. So, I'm also for it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I have no complaints!
Let us take this opportunity as those who truly love shows to learn as much as we can from one another!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Ah, wonderful.
Then, we'll let them know right away.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We feel bad about dumping this on you so suddenly, but do your best during your last ambassadorial performance, okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, how many people do you think are gonna come? I really don't feel great about performing with a whole load of new people...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nonsense! You're going to be a world-famous songstress! You should have more confidence in yourself!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, he's right!
You're gonna knock their socks off!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Just by being confident?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Speaking of which, where will we be performing exactly?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: At the Museum of Emerging Technologies that's about to have its grand opening. Here's a pamphlet for it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That means we'll also be advertising the museum itself! We'll need to do our best for this!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...!
This place looks so cool! And shiny!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: This museum seems to focus on the near future and has exhibits that introduce state-of-the-art technologies from around the world. The plaza outside will be your stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The near future...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm already getting some interesting ideas.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In any case, let's all do our best to put on the best show we can together.
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We're here!
Where do you think Miku and the others are!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If they're not here, they're probably at KAITO's tent, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, let's go go go!
I really wanna tell them about our next show♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure they'll want to join in on the action. Miku in particular is probably going to exclaim, “That sounds like fun☆ I wanna be in it too☆”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree.
...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...?
What's wrong, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, um... I was just wondering about something...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wondering about what?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Just how many of my ideas the cast members from ArcLand are going to be willing to accept?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, don't worry.
It's not actually bothering me that much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, after that wedding, the night show and the Sports Festival... I've come to understand that not all are willing to go along with my ideas...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But it's okay.
I was simply wondering how far I'll be able to go with our final ambassadorial performance.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm sure we'll get to do lots!
I mean, your ideas are always super duper fun, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly!! Your directing is invaluable to us!! I say use whatever ideas you see fit!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you all very much.
I said NO!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: No, I wanna do it! I'm gonna do it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm?
Those voices...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, look over there! It's Miku and everyone!
What are they doing?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ah, there you all are.
Unfortunately, we have a slight situation on our hands...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What kind of situation?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: See the birdie plushie talking to Miku right now? They're arguing about whether or not to do a show on the flying train.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, on the train?
We did that with KAITO once.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That's actually the reason.
Our feathery friend here wishes to do the same thing...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A show that's full of acrobatic stunts performed on top of the train.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: On top of it? With everyone? That sounds pretty dangerous...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I agree...
Doing a show like that has certainly crossed my mind before...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: From what I saw before, there's no way to actually operate the train, and it seems to just fly off on its own sometimes. As a result, that endeavor ended up being too risky.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We even thought about how to use wires and such, but couldn't think of what to do if they got tangled up...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, we said that we shouldn't do a show up there. But...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, it'd be pretty hard to pull off if you can't fly like a birdie. And even the others who can fly said they were scared...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: But I can do it!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: I don't care if no one else can! I'll do it by myself!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What?!
W-Wait!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As much as they want to do a show, no one else is willing to participate...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That sounds like the old me.
I wish I could help out somehow...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
We also want to help.
That's why we've been trying to come up with an alternative.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to take up so much of your time with this... You're all here to practice, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Actually, we stopped by to tell you about what we'll be doing for our next show.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? Please continue.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As it turns out, we're going to be performing a show alongside some cast members from the world-famous theme park, ArcLand.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds like fun!
Do you know what your show is going to be about?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not yet. We're scheduled to meet with them tomorrow. Our plan is to discuss ideas with them when we do.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Break a leg, everyone!
This should end up being a nice experience for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you. We hope so too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Miku's back...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Birdie flew away...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... What do we do? Isn't there a way for us to do a fun show together...? Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, when did you guys get here...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
We heard about what happened.
How are things going? It sounds like you're in a tough pickle...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... Well...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I really don't know what to do...
And Birdie flew away all angry and frustrated...
*Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But sighing isn't gonna help us put on a fun show...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll keep trying to come up with a way that the plushies can do one...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too.
Let's work together so that they can put on a good show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Please feel free to ask us if you need any help.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay!
Thanks!
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm...
As glad as I am that we got to tell them about our next show, it was a bit strange to see them in such a predicament.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it was...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shows can involve a large number of people all fixated on different goals, which can lead to some unpleasant situations.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
We'll need to keep that in mind for our own show...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Us too?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, because we're gonna be performing with a new set of people. There's probably gonna be some growing pains...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We'll be fine!
We just have to get to know each other and...! Oh, I know! We should have some food or snacks together! Then we'll be friends in no time!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. What, like eating from the same plate or something?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Actually, that may not be a bad idea.
We should do that if we get the chance.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay!
Then, let's do our best to put on an excellent show together!
Two days later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm...!
Soon... No, not yet... But they should be...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This feels like déjà vu...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I guess he did the same thing the day before yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I can't wait for them to get here♪
How should we greet them? Oh, what if I flew down from above?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That'd definitely get their attention, but you'd also probably scare them. Let's save that for some other time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, let's save it for then!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Alright, it's just about time...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke's Voice
rows.Line: Please enjoy the rest of your visit.
Yes, we intend to!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm! Is that...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm seeing... Seven of them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, that person at the front looks really familiar...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-Isn't that Asahi Genbu?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Asahi Genbu...?
Wait, THE Asahi Genbu?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Where?! Gen-who?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Genbu. His name's Genbu.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Asahi Genbu... He's a young actor who's been attracting quite a bit of attention lately. On top of being a central figure at ArcLand, he's been appearing in movies and TV shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He's supposed to be a remarkable actor, so I'm looking forward to seeing how he performs in person.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, he's also famous for being among the first to be asked to perform at the Center Theatre.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The Center Theatre...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, ArcLand has a lot of stages, but you can only perform on that one if you're both young and really good.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: ArcLand certainly has been putting a lot of resources into their stage performances recently. They've been recruiting the best up-and-coming actors and directors, while also providing them with an environment in which they can all thrive.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'd seen Asahi Genbu a number of times before on TV... But to think that he's actually here...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Th-This pregnant pause...!
Wh-What's going on?!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No, calm down! A star should know how to keep their cool in these situations. Just greet him like normal and...)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It's...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It's really you!! WXS in the flesh!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Everyone! It's really WXS!
Look, it's Miles! He's literally right in front of us...!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Miles?!
O-Oh, from the night show...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: W-Would it be okay if we shook hands?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: O-Of course!! Why not...?!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: C-Calm down, Asahi!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
How can I?!
They're WXS! The ones who came up with that night show!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Haha... I guess there wasn't much we could do to avoid this...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-He's way different from what I was expecting...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He seems really fun and energetic!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh no! I'm sorry, I forgot to introduce myself!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
My name is Asahi Genbu.
I'm beyond ecstatic about being given this opportunity to put on a show with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: We're cast members for Tokyo ArcLand's Center Theatre, and we very much look forward to working with you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, uh...!
We look forward to working with you as well!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We are Wonderlands×Showtime!
And I am the troupe leader, Tsukasa Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe.
He's very different compared to when he appears on TV and such...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But he seems like an interesting person.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I-I'm Nene Kusanagi...
I started acting when I was little after joining a children's theatre group. One thing led to another and I ended up performing at the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Also... I like singing very much!
I-I'm looking forward to working with all of you, and promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Geez, I thought my heart was gonna stop...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was a really wonderhoy speech, Nene! Oh, it might've been more wonderhoy if you sang!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: M-Maybe next time...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've had a chance to introduce ourselves, why don't we start discussing the details for our ambassadorial performance?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! Then, can I start?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Since we're gonna be performing at the Museum of Emerging Technologies, what if we did something futuristic?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: F-Futuristic? You always come up with these vague suggestions...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, but...
I think she has the right idea. I mean, we usually try to match these performances to the venue's theme.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Right...
As usual, it's best to make the most out of where we'll be.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sure our audience will also appreciate how it goes with the museum's theme and see it as a special experience.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Ah, I see...
So that's how you come up with your ideas for shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We generally try to fully utilize the stage or venue for our performances. Besides that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I want to make full use of the talent ArcLand has given us.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Asahi Genbu in particular since he's multitalented... He has a knack for quickly getting into character for whatever role he's assigned. Some even call him a genius for being able to do that...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only that, but Tsukasa, Nene and Emu stand to learn quite a bit from seeing him perform.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Ideally, we'll be able to maximize what we get out of this experience.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Especially for the sake of Tsukasa and Nene, who both dream of seeing the world.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So, something that makes use of our venue while also helping improve everybody's skills...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I suggest that we do “The Two Androids”.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “The Two Androids”?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Ah, yes...
That would go well with the museum.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you familiar with “The Two Androids”, Genbu?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It's a hidden gem in terms of science-fiction stories. A friend of mine recommended it to me and read it for the first time at a library in Japan when I was in sixth grade.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, what a coincidence.
I read the Yoshio Ueda translation when I was in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: You too, Kamishiro?! That's the version I read! But looking back, I had a lot of trouble getting my head around how it was written...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. So did I.
I'm not sure it was meant to be read by elementary schoolers.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Exactly!
I tried reading the original when I was in junior high school and actually had an easier time understanding it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I already had a hunch, but I suppose it's only natural for the young stars of ArcLand to have been exposed to old classics like this one...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But he said “a library in Japan” just now... Does that mean he spent time living abroad for a time?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, what's “The Two Androids” actually about?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, about that.
Allow me to give a quick synopsis...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It takes place 100 years in the future in a laboratory where the two androids reside.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They were so new that the professor who made them still hadn't gotten around to programming in any knowledge.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, one day, other humans discover them. Soldiers from Nations A and B.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Both sides sought to weaponize them, which led to each nation taking one android for themselves.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: With a bit of luck, Alfred, the android that was taken by Nation A, managed to escape the clutches of the military and find refuge in the home of some kind-hearted pioneers at the edge of the wilderness. Alfred would begin learning more about the world.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Meanwhile, Bartlett, the android that was taken by Nation B, underwent the process of becoming a weapon of war.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no! That's terrible!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: But it makes for an interesting story.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, during the final scene, they're reunited in the battle-scarred wasteland that was the pioneers' home.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: One android was taught the value of human kindness, while the other was only shown how to cruelly inflict pain onto others. Despite originating from the same place, they ended up walking down starkly different paths.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What happens next?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What happens next...? Hehe...
You'll just have to read the script to find out.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're really not gonna tell us?! You pretty much told us the whole story!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna know too!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Haha! You're quite the storyteller.
But I agree. You should all read what happens for yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, my point exactly.
So, Genbu, promise not to tell them what happens.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Of course!
Oh, speaking of which...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Please, call me Asahi.
If it's okay with all of you, I'd like to call you by your first names as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, Asahi, please do.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, now that we have our story, let's start choosing roles!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, about that.
I actually have an idea regarding who will be leading...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd like you and Asahi to play our two androids, Tsukasa. How does that sound?
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Asahi and I as the two androids...?
So, in other words, you want two leads for this show?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be fair, Alfred's technically the main protagonist of this story.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Especially considering how Alfred goes from being a mindless machine to a sentient being with real emotions.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, Bartlett plays a key role during the last scene. So in essence, the show has two leads.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Yes, that sounds really interesting!
I'd be honored to be one of the protagonists alongside Miles.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Likewise...!
This should end up being a very good learning experience.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, who's going to be playing which android?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I actually don't want to make a decision just yet.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The truth is, Asahi, I still don't know much about your acting style.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like you two to try playing both roles in order for me to see who's more suited for which role.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see. Good idea, Rui.
I have no problem with that!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Me neither! That actually makes things more exciting!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you both very much.
If it's okay with all of you, I'd like to think more about the other roles once I get home.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: I can't wait to read the script!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Okay, that went rather smoothly, and everyone seems to be in a good mood...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, the hard part starts now. Between deciding how they need to act, what stunts and effects to use and working with the cast members of ArcLand, there's a lot of work up ahead.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Regardless...
I should just proceed the way I normally do and give it my best.)
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now that we all have our roles, I'd like for us to do a table read today. Once again, I look forward to putting on a good show with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As do I!!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Same here! I'm really looking forward to this!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's still the morning, but everyone sounds so fired up♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-We have two shouters now...?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh, by the way, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Which roles do you want Tsukasa and me to play for the time being? You're going to make your final decision later, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For now, Asahi, I'd like you to play Alfred, the android that gets taken by Nation A. As such, Tsukasa, I'd like you to play Bartlett, the android that gets taken by Nation B.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd also like it if you two could swap roles depending on the scene and how we do during our read.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Unfortunately, that means you two will each have to learn both roles...

rows.Speaker: Asahi & Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No problem!
Leave it to me!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As for the rest of you... Emu, you'll be playing the girl who finds Alfred at the edge of the wilderness. Nene, you'll be playing Bartlett's drill sergeant.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, let's begin our table read.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Good morning, Alfred. How are you...?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Again...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui, I thought we were just getting our feet wet with this one...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I apologize for interrupting you this early, but you just didn't sound like an android just now. Would you mind giving it another try...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Like an android...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That sounds really hard.
I'm not sure how I'd play one...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm...
“G00D M0RN1N6! ALFR3D!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Does that count as being an android...?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Rui, would you mind if Tsukasa and I tried going through that opening conversation together?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, of course.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Let's give it a try, Tsukasa!
I'll also do my best at playing an android!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you...
Then, let's go through it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Good morning, Alfred. How are you...?”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “Good morning, Bartlett. I am good.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (H-Huh? What's happening...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Asahi's spoken only one line, but it's like I'm speaking to a completely different person...)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “Such wonderful weather, and just the right temperature. The Professor will surely be pleased.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(*Gasp*
I see. I was under the impression that an android shouldn't speak with too much intonation...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But it's the opposite. These androids were made to communicate with humans, so they should speak in a slightly robotic fashion that's easy for a human listener to understand.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “The Professor should enjoy this nice weather by going outside of the laboratory for a change...”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “That is unlikely. The Professor is like a mole and this laboratory is his underground den.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Indeed.
If only we could do something about that habit of his.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“Who are you comparing to a mole?
Have you both forgotten that I am your creator?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Asahi
rows.Line: “Professor.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that was good.
You both still need time to get used to working with one another, but try to keep in mind what you just did.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I see...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you very much, Asahi.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Haha. There's no need to thank me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, there is. I have a slightly better understanding of how to play an android thanks to you.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Really?! Great!
That just leaves...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: ...understanding what was going through the Professor's mind as he built these androids. That should help you even more.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I see...
I was convinced that playing android simply meant behaving like one...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But understanding the reasoning behind the Professor making these androids, as well as why they are the way they are...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(So many questions...
Why were they originally made? How human did he want them to become...?)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: H-Huh?! Don't mind me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You two really seemed like androids just now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You really surprised me with your acting, Asahi. Also, I'm glad Tsukasa managed to catch on.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Asahi may have an even bigger impact on Tsukasa than I initially expected...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, let's continue.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “What's the meaning of this? Did others decide to break into this laboratory at the same time as us?”

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line:
“Stay frosty, Sergeant Willis!
This is a battlefield now!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “C-Copy...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(S-Such a loud voice...!
It's making my ears shiver...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But I see what they're doing...
There's no way to tell what's gonna happen on a real battlefield with real weapons, so it makes sense to act that way...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Huh?
Look, Mom, it's a person! I think they collapsed!”

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Oh, Emu, you might not want to announce your presence like that for this scene.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: There aren't supposed to be many soldiers around at the edge of the wilderness, but this person could be one.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I get it!
I'll try to be more discreet!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I should expect no less from ArcLand's cast members. It's only been a few days since we chose what we'll be performing, but they all seem to have already thoroughly gone over the story...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Asahi in particular. Alfred is hardly an easy role, but it appears that he knows exactly what to do.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only that, but he doesn't seem to be breaking a sweat. So...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (How is Tsukasa going to react to this...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Even though it was meant to be just a quick table read, there's a clear skill gap between me and him...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(And it's not just Asahi...
They only had a few days, but his fellow cast members have also thoroughly studied their roles.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (On top of that, they seem to have studied the others' roles as well in order to make sure we put on a good performance. All the while, I'm too busy thinking about my own character...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(No, stop...!
A star shouldn't be feeling so down!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (A skill gap simply means I need to find a way to get better!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Remember how you learned to play Thorpe! It's how you're going to become a world-famous star!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, let's try reading through the story until the end!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Sob*
This story's so good...

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: That final scene on the battlefield was so moving...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I'm glad they were able to understand each other in the end.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you all liked it so much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Okay, we seem to be in a good spot. However, we'll have a few variables to deal with moving forward...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (For example, how many of my ideas will the others be willing to accept?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now that we've finished our table read, I'd like to start thinking about the stunts and effects we'll be using for the opening scene.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The opening scene? You mean when there's a raid on the lab?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: The moment when the androids' daily lives are torn to shreds... It's very dramatic. I'm looking forward to seeing how it turns out.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, in order to give it that dramatic feel...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm thinking about having you all perform an actual raid.
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: An actual raid?

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: What do you mean by that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Maybe that wasn't the best way to put it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My goal is to use the raid in the beginning to raise the excitement level for the show. That's why I'd like for it to be as real as possible.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
But how do we do that exactly?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll be performing at the plaza in front of the museum, no? I noticed that a handful of lamp posts line the area.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We can use those to signal the start of the attack. Specifically, I'm thinking about having the commander stand on top of them as they give the order.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: On top of them?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
I've already received permission from the museum.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The lamps are wide and flat on top, so it's actually possible to stand on top of them. I'm planning on making a prop for support that can be attached to one's lower back.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, they're about five meters tall, so we'll also need to prepare a lifeline and safety mats just in case the worst happens.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Five meters...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line:
...
Okay, can we test that out?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Test it out?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Yes, a test is a good idea!
Let's see... Oh, that gate over there seems to be about five meters high.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Emu, can we try climbing on top of that gate over there?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, no problem!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Alright, let's tie this lifeline onto you and... You're all set to climb!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line:
Okay...
Asahi, mind reading the line before mine for me?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Sure!
The security guard's line, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-They seem pretty used to doing stuff like this...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “Intruders!! All hands on deck!!”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “They must be after the androids in the underground laboratory, Alfred and Bartlett!! Whoa!!”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “Geez, they've already made it this far...!”

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line:
“The laboratory is ours!
However, we don't appear to be alone...”

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line:
“No matter...
Professor Christopher Hawking! Surrender and bring those androids of yours to us at once!!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa, that was so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I-I'm staggered...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It's a little dangerous, but I do agree that orders sound more compelling when literally given from up high!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: But we'll be in full view of the audience as we climb. We didn't exactly look cool while we did, so we should think of a way to cover for that.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: We'll also want to look cool while dropping down. Remember those poles we used during that one show? What if we used them for this scene?

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member C
rows.Line: Okay, let's ask to see if we can borrow them from the theater!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So this is what ArcLand's cast members are capable of...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Even if a stunt is clearly dangerous, they're willing to consider the value in it instead of outright deciding against it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only that, but they're able to come up with ways to improve and implement it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've never experienced anything like this before...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Okay, Rui, that should allow us to implement your idea!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
With regards to this stunt, I'd like to keep polishing it while receiving input from all of you.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Alright, sounds like a plan!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, let's begin practicing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“What is the meaning of this?
Where are the laboratory's security guards?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Again, Tsukasa, you're an android!
You sound far too shaken! Act more robotic!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I understand that it's an emotional scene, but it may be better to not give each word so much weight. Try saying your lines like you're saying A-E-I-O-U.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
Let me try that again.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line:
“Sergeant Willis!
Have you apprehended the Professor?!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“We still can't find him...
There's no sign of him in the lab!”

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Am I right in saying that you're more the stationary type, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? Y-Yes...
Compared to the others, I don't tend to move around all that much...

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: I see. Then, let's try going over the scene where we're looking for the Professor together. We're soldiers, so we need to look the part.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Okay!
I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, what if we did something like this when we burst in through the doors?! Ka-pow!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line:
Hey, that looks fun!
Lemme try it too! Ka-pow!!
se_event_curtaincall_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! That was so cool!! How did you manage to go all twirly-whirly?!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. It's supposed to be a trade secret... But if you really wanna know...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I do! Please teach me!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... I'm exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Nice work, Nene.
How do you feel?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Tired... I've been using all my energy just to keep up with the others. They're too good.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But they've also been giving me some advice here and there, which is really nice. Still, it's amazing how they can pull off all these crazy stunts. It's like they're all Seiryuin.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I know what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (ArcLand's cast members are certainly very skilled.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Some are definitely as good as Seiryuin, the prima donna of the Phoenix Stage. On top of that, they have Asahi, who's in a league of his own.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I was afraid that the others would feel somewhat dejected when faced with such a skill gap...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But they seem to be taking it in stride...)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Asahi?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh, I was just thinking about how to act out this part.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: During the raid, Alfred becomes unable to walk after being shot in the foot, right?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Since we'll be performing our show at a big plaza, I'm wondering if our audience will be able to actually see me if I'm on all fours... I'm thinking that we ask Rui to set up some sort of platform.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
By the way, how do you plan to play him during that scene?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh, something like this.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “Bartlett...”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “I cannot move any further... Go on without me.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I thought this when his fellow cast member climbed on top of the gate...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But Asahi and them all make full use of body language in their performances. It's a far cry from our abilities.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Not only do they have a deep understanding of their roles, but they can get into character at the snap of a finger. Even something as difficult as being an android...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Furthermore, despite being an emotionless android, he's able to make each scene incredibly impactful.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It's as if we're on a real battlefield...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Such acting talent...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, that should be enough practice for today.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, we practiced so much today!
I'm super tired!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can see why. We're dealing with roles that are more difficult than usual and involve quite a bit more action.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As a result, my stomach is...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whose stomach just growled...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, Tsukasa, that wasn't you?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I thought it was you too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nonsense!
Yes, I'm hungry, but...

rows.Speaker: Asahi

rows.Line: We shouldn't let this opportunity slip. Not when it means we may get to ask them about how they usually practice and such.

rows.Line:
R-Right...
We don't get many chances like this...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I wanna go too!
Let's have a big feast!!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: How about you, Rui? Will you be able to join us?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes...
I'd also like to go.

rows.Line: Cheers!!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Cheers!
Cheers.

rows.Line: Now, today was the first rehearsal where we all used our scripts... How did everyone do in your guys' opinion?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Naturally, we were very impressed by ArcLand's cast members. You certainly are a world-class bunch...

rows.Line: On top of being wonderful actors, you're willing to listen to others and provide suggestions for improvement in order to make the show as good as it can be. I couldn't be more grateful.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I agree...
And we all seemed to learn quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Practicing with all of you made me realize that I still have a lot of work to do.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's so much that I still don't know... If I'm going to have any hope of becoming a world-famous star, I'll need to keep learning as much as I can.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Ah, don't worry about me!
I plan on using this experience to soar to even greater heights.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Especially since working with such skilled actors means we get to learn new things from one another. So, I hope we get to keep doing that until the curtains go up on the day of.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Of course! I'd like that as well!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh, Rui, there's actually something that I've been meaning to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Is it just me or is your directing style heavily influenced by Tom Gray?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What...?
Yes, that's right. How did you...?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
I knew it!
The way you had us do the raid scene today reminded me of the heist scene from “Acclamation of Anger”.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Yeah, I totally get what you're talking about! The way he made things more dramatic by drawing the viewer's eyes up was so Tom Gray.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
I've seen all of Tom Gray's shows at least a hundred times!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Yeah, we get that you're a huge fanatic. But I get the feeling that you're also a pretty big fan, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I am...
I suspect that I've also seen all his shows about that many times.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Ah, my comrade!
No matter how many times I see the shows he directed, I can never get tired of them! Am I right?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I know exactly what you mean.
I was particularly taken aback by how “Acclamation of Anger” pays homage to three of his other works.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line:
Wait, three?
I didn't know that!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Do you want to become a director like Tom Gray, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
Just like him...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “It doesn't matter if you're rich or poor, clever or foolish, among the majority or minority...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “All people laugh, cry and feel anger in the same way...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “That is what ties us all together after bearing witness to a truly marvelous spectacle.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I want to keep making those kinds of shows.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That's what he said during an interview...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I had a feeling that you knew.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Of course. I mean, what he said really hit home with me!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I had the honor of hearing Tom tell me that in person...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: There was a time when I lived abroad because of my parents' work, but we somehow found ourselves in the middle of a conflict.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A conflict...?!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: This may be hard to believe, but we suddenly began hearing gunfire. Before long, my windows were being shot out...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
It was so scary.
My heart still races every time I think about what happened.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That reminds me of...)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It's a hidden gem in terms of science-fiction stories. A friend of mine recommended it to me and read it for the first time at a library in Japan when I was in sixth grade.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Now I see. What he really meant was...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It's as if we're on a real battlefield...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That's his lived experience...)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Then, as my parents and I were trying to flee, I got separated from them...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I didn't know what to do, but this old lady helped me out by giving me a ride in her car... As luck would have it, I was able to make it to the border.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I felt better after I saw that there were a lot of people waiting there, but that wasn't the end of it...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I didn't really know the local language since I was only in elementary school, and I hadn't heard any news about my parents. I really thought the world was ending.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That was when I met Tom Gray.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What was he doing there?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: He was from the neighboring country and was volunteering to help refugees.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
I had no idea who he was.
But when he tried to hand me some bread, I said, "I don't want that. I want a way to not be alone."

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Then, he suddenly stood up and replied, “Now is the perfect time to put on a show for children such as yourself.”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It was incredible. Alongside his volunteering duties, he somehow made costumes, props and even a stage out of the refuse and rubble that was lying around. After that, he made reflectors out of the pull tabs he'd taken off some cans and hung them from the roof. I remember how shiny they were.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: The show he did was about a child who'd become separated from everyone due to war and how these strange animals took care of him until he was able to reunite with his parents...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
It was so fun and exciting.
I almost thought that it was about me...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It really felt like a dream.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: And thanks to Tom's show, I was able to find my parents.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: All because this photo of a certain child who looked completely entranced by his performance was printed in a newspaper.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That sounds like an unforgettable memory...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
It is!
After all, Tom's my hero!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That was when I decided that I wanted to work in show business, and began studying to become an actor...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Then, I learned about ArcLand and the Center Theatre.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I'd already had some interest in ArcLand since it was famous for being a theme park that put on world-class shows.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: So, I came up with the idea of putting on shows at the Center Theatre that bring the world together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shows that bring the world together...?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Haha. I guess that needs more explaining...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: In other words, ArcLand is currently working to do shows like the one Tom showed me.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: For all those people out there who are somehow surviving but are unable to smile...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: The cast of the Center Theatre plans to do shows around the world just for them.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Right now, we're sort of trying to build the foundation for that. Our goal is to perform at venues all over Japan.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Once we've accomplished that, we want to travel around the world putting on charity shows and volunteer events.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: We know that not everywhere is safe, and we're trying our best to get a full understanding of that. But we want to do this.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: So, in order to produce shows that transcend borders, we need to start by putting on shows in as many places as we can!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Members
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shows that bring the world together...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(I see...
Asahi and the others have the same dream as me.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But they're much closer to achieving it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Hehe.
I can't help but feel somewhat anxious.)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I think I'm so enamored with your directing style, Rui, because you also look up to Tom. I mean, you guys' night show was just so spectacular.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
We appreciate your kind words.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: But to think that you're still in high school. Yes, Tom's clearly had a big effect on you, but it's obvious that you've also developed your own style.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh!
Of course he has!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What are you acting all high and mighty about?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But Rui really is amazing!
All his ideas always go BANG-ZOOM-BOOM!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Hahaha!
He definitely likes throwing in some flashy effects.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
I know!
Why don't you come join us and become our director?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line:
Whoa! Slow down!
You can't go asking the director of another troupe to just up and leave!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
W-Wait, I was joking!
I couldn't help it. He's just such a good director...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You really had us going there!
se_event_curtaincall_2022_002

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe...
This sort of banter is nice every once in a while.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: (It is meant in jest...)
se_event_curtaincall_2022_002

rows.Line: But I think it'd be really fun if you did join us.

...

rows.Line: (However...)

How can I help you?

rows.Line: (He goes through a process of developing real emotions, so playing him will require a delicate touch.)

rows.Line: (However, I'd also like for him to connect with the audience by adding a more human element.)

rows.Line: Will be played by... Asahi.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, I suspected as much...

rows.Line:
Asahi was perfect in every aspect.
It genuinely felt like I was speaking to an android.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Precisely...

rows.Line: Also, I came to the conclusion that I needed someone who can present the process of developing real emotions in an elegant manner.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I chose Asahi.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
No.
I think you can do more, Tsukasa.

rows.Line: What?

You're a future star, no?
You should be able to handle that scene without any issues.

rows.Line: I began wondering if your talent for expressing yourself was actually holding you back.

rows.Line: If you found a way to hold back your thoughts and feelings... Then let just a little bit eke out during that scene... Would you mind practicing that tonight?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa

rows.Line:

Okay!
Get home safe!

rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Line: I know this is going to feel very sudden.

rows.Line: And I know it's the day before our show, but I need to ask you this...

rows.Line: How would you like to work at ArcLand?

rows.Line: You're still in high school, so you'd probably be hired as a part-timer... But I have a feeling that they'd make you a full employee in no time.

rows.Line: So... You're headhunting me?

rows.Line: Yes, that's one way to put it...

rows.Line: Seeing you in person convinced me...

rows.Line: With you, I have a feeling that we'd be able to put on a show that brings everyone in the world together... Like the way Tom did...

rows.Line: As a director, you're bold and not afraid to ask others to do some wild things...

rows.Line:

I'm constantly at the edge of my seat wondering what you're going to say or how you're going to respond next.

rows.Line: That's why I want to work alongside you, Rui...

rows.Line: I greatly appreciate what you just said, but...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I'm confident that your addition will lead to the rest of us becoming better actors.
