rows.Line: And you becoming a better director.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: The Center Theatre at ArcLand is a venue where only those with the potential to become world-class stars are able to perform.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I'm sure directing such a cast would be unbelievably fun for you since you'd be able to put on shows beyond your wildest imagination... Shows that can bring the world together...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: So, how does working with us at ArcLand sound?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I really wasn't expecting to be asked to work at ArcLand...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Few directors would ever be considered for such an offer...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And in terms of my dream...)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I know this is very sudden and a lot to process. To tell you the truth, I wasn't planning on asking you here...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: So, you don't have to give an answer right now. Please let me know once you've had some time to think about it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, understood...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Again, I apologize for surprising you like this. Anyway, I'll see you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay.
See you tomorrow...
Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: How would you like to work at ArcLand?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I never imagined being given such an offer...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The night before our show too, no less.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (In terms of making my dream come true, I couldn't ask for a better situation...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (ArcLand provides the best environment for those who wish to put on or perform in shows.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (With one of the largest troupes out there. A troupe that excels at cultivating young talent.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And if their actors are willing to place their faith in me as a director, there's no question that we'd be able to do some unimaginable things together...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But above all else...)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: So, I came up with the idea of putting on shows at the Center Theatre that bring the world together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shows that bring the world together...?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Haha. I guess that needs more explaining...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: In other words, ArcLand is currently working to do shows like the one Tom showed me.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: For all those people out there who are somehow surviving but are unable to smile...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: The cast of the Center Theatre plans to do shows around the world just for them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They're genuinely trying to transcend beyond what it means to be a show.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And yet...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why was I unable to give an immediate response...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (No, wait, there's nothing wrong with that...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Because... If I leave, Wonderlands×Showtime will no longer have a director.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only that, but I'd be dashing the hopes of everybody who wants to see us perform... That pains me the most...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And above all else...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I... I want to make my dream come true.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And we can't all stay at the Wonder Stage forever.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The time will inevitably come when I and the others will have to part ways...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (All of us...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We put on shows while being supportive of each other's dreams.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So I'm sure they'll be willing to accept my decision if it means I get to make mine come true.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And I'd happily support the others if they were in a similar situation.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (At least, I think I would...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Which is why I...)
Rui!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Nene's Voice
rows.Line: Emu, I didn't mean yell from the window like that! Oh, but I think we got his attention...

rows.Speaker: Nene's Voice
rows.Line: Are you just getting home?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...!
But why's Emu at your place, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene's Voice
rows.Line: We had some time and decided to go through the story together! I was actually just about to walk Emu out...

rows.Speaker: Nene's Voice
rows.Line: Wait here one sec...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks for taking care of the shopping. Based on those bags, I take it you found what we needed?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Luckily, I had Tsukasa and Asahi there to help...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay...
Hmm... But you seem kinda tired.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I do? What makes you think that?
I feel just fine.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You looked a little unhappy is all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, maybe it's because we've been rehearsing nonstop the past few days...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I promise to get a good night's sleep tonight. So, I'll be off to do just that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Did something happen while you guys were out shopping?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That face you just made... It reminded me of the old you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Like you're trying to bury away something important...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's just...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So something did happen?
Tell us! Maybe we can help!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
If it's really bothering you, don't try to deal with it all on your own.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We're standing here today because we've been helping each other out when we can up until now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right...
Until now, we...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's okay. You don't have to tell us.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I get it. Sometimes, you just don't know how to explain what's going on...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, you don't have to tell us right now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You can tell us when you feel ready.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But I'm sorry. I really should go now.
Emu, please get home safe...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
O-Okay...!
Bye bye, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is he gonna be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I have no idea. But...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My gut tells me that it's not gonna be an easy problem to solve...
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ahh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
The dazzling scenery in the distance...
I'm never going to get tired of looking at it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's so soothing that I've developed a habit of coming here whenever I need some time alone to think.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But what am I doing here? Honestly...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I should be telling the others about things that concern my dream...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(I know that..
But...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (What is this pain I'm feeling?)

Oh no!
What do we do?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Uhh... Hang on... Lie down here...!
Are you thirsty? Would you like some water? No, wait, you're a plushie...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: I'm okay... I can stand...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Are you sure?
You don't have to if you don't think you can.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What in the world happened here...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: R-Rui!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um, so... Remember how Birdie wanted to do a show on top of the flying train?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
You all decided against it because it would've been too dangerous...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, but they decided to do a show all on their own.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What? Alone?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
They ended up going a bit overboard and collapsed after their show ended...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: But I'm all better now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You did a show all by yourself?
That's very courageous of you, but it must've been very hard...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was!
Just setting everything up made my head hurt!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: And... It was kinda lonely...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, I bet...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Putting on fun shows is a really wonderful thing...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But it's gotta feel so lonely when the people you care about aren't there with you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That's it...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Despite already having an answer ready, the reason I'm still dwelling on this is because...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I still want to...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I still want to keep doing shows with them...)

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: B-But...!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: As lonely as it was, I had fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: I got to do what I really wanted to do, and it ended up being super duper fun!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
It's too bad we couldn't put on a show together...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'm really glad you enjoyed doing it so much!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line:
Me too!!
Thanks, Miku!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're super welcome!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Huh?
Rui, what's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was just thinking about my future...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I know this is sudden...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But would you mind listening to what's going on with me for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You'd have to go work with them if you really want to make your dream come true...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But a part of me still wants to do shows with my friends.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I hardly ever find myself being so maudlin...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I know that the others are prepared to accept some tough decisions when it comes to our individual dreams.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But to think I'd have this much trouble coming to a decision. I feel like a child.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, don't say that!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It just means that moving on to make your dream come true and wanting to be with your friends are both really important to you, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Actually, I realized just now that I really understand how Birdie felt...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As lonely as it was to do a show all alone, it must've been really fun to do everything they wanted...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, you should think really, really, really hard about this decision! For the sake of you now and you in the future, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because I have a feeling that you won't be happy if you don't!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I really appreciate how you always listen to our concerns.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll try giving it some more thought and see which way I should go...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good...!
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's always been my dream to produce a show that transcends shows. Something that has the power to put a smile on everyone's faces around the world...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But on the other hand...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (A part of me wants to keep doing shows with them. Forever...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (If I turn down Asahi, I'll have the opportunity to do that...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However...)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: As a director, you're bold and not afraid to ask others to do some wild things...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
But that excites me.
I'm constantly at the edge of my seat wondering what you're going to say or how you're going to respond next.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That's why I want to work alongside you, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: B-But...!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: As lonely as it was, I had fun!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: I got to do what I really wanted to do, and it ended up being super duper fun!!
The next day
Museum of Emerging Technologies - Main Gate Plaza

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Please bring that large prop over here. Yes, next to this pole will do just fine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, Rui!
Is this spot about where we should be entering?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Mind showing me?
Maybe ten centimeters closer towards stage left...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, Tsukasa, did you sleep well last night...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! I stayed up to practice as much as I could, but managed to get in just enough sleep!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All that's left is to do my best during the show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Right.
I'll be looking forward to seeing a great performance from you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How are you doing, Asahi...?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Oh, the mats are all set!
They should be able to stay in place regardless of what's thrown at them!

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Hey, what are they doing over there?

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Oh, let's see what the poster says.
PXL and ArcLand are doing a show together...?!

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
Whoa, really?!
And Asahi Genbu's gonna be in it! Wanna check it out?

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Wait, Asahi's gonna be in it?
Yeah, definitely!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui still seems kinda unhappy...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, but he seems a little better compared to yesterday...

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line:
Hm? Nene, Emu, what's wrong?
Are you feeling nervous?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Urgh!
N-No, we feel fine! Better than fine!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Really? Then, I guess there's nothing to worry about... Please let us know if something is wrong. We'll do our best to help.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Okay.
We really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He said he was fine when we made our way over here this morning...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But maybe the four of us should set aside some time after the show to talk...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, it's nearly showtime.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll be doing three performances over two days for this. I know this still feels a bit strange since it's the first show we're doing together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I strongly believe we'll be able to really deliver.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, let's all do our best.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Asahi
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's give them the best show they've ever seen.

rows.Speaker: Major
rows.Line:
“The laboratory is ours!
However, we don't appear to be alone...”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Wait, they're on top of the lamps! When did they get up there?!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Cool!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Excellent. The audience is captivated, just as we planned.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The next moment's also one of the most important parts of the show since it's going to give them a nice jolt of excitement.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That aspect of the show is second nature to our guests, while...)

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“Major! There's only one android!
Our intel said that there'd be two...”

rows.Speaker: Major
rows.Line: “It must've been taken by those rats...! We'll pursue after them! Sergeant Willis, you are to secure the android that you've already found!”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “Copy!”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “What happened? Where is the Professor? Please, explain to me what is going on...”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“Explain...?
Well...”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“You belong to us now.
So, you'll be taking orders from us.”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “But only the Professor can change who has administrator privileges over my systems. Where is he? Is he safe?”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“He isn't here anymore...
Sorry, but we'll just have to change those by brute force.”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “Hmm... Apologizing to an android feels a bit strange.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Tsukasa and Nene have improved their acting quite a bit. They certainly seem to have absorbed as much as they could from ArcLand's cast members.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I couldn't be more blessed to have them...

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line:
“Wh-Where am I?
I require positioning data for this area.”

rows.Speaker: Emma
rows.Line: “Here? It's the farm my grandpa started out here on the frontier, Mr. Robot! We found you collapsed on the ground!”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line:
“I am not a robot. I am an android.
My name is Alfred Hawking.”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “Have you downloaded the map for where the next battle is going to take place?”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “Yes. I have also found the evacuation routes that the civilians will likely be using.”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “Were you ordered to do that...?”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “Yes. I was told that it would be absolutely necessary for this battle. Do you have any issues with that...?”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “Not really...”

rows.Speaker: Emma
rows.Line:
“Al, help!
What do I do?! One of the calves ran away!”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line:
“What?! No!
We must go after it at once!”

rows.Speaker: Emma
rows.Line:
“Thanks, Al!
Wait, watch out for the manure pit...”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “Wah!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The two androids who ended up being raised in two completely different environments...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, as the front lines near the peaceful farmland, Alfred is forced to take up arms for the very first time in order to protect its residents.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And our two androids are reunited on the battlefield...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Now, here comes the show's climax.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Break a leg, everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “My systems have been augmented specifically for the battlefield. How are you able to stand your ground against me?”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line:
“I... I do not know...
But I...”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line:
“I want to protect these people.
That may be the reason why I am able to summon more strength than I normally can.”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “I do not understand.”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “Please, just try!!”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line:
“No, I will not.
I cannot fathom your motives.”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “I do not wish to kill you, Bartlett!!”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “The only thing that separates us is the environments in which we were raised!”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “We would not be doing this right now if you were not taught to kill!”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “But that is what I was taught. That is reality. So, I must defeat you.”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “Bartlett!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Towards the end of the battle, Alfred somehow manages to damage Bartlett's power core...)

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “Ba-Ba-Bartlett...!!”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line:
“Why are you crying...?
You are the victor.”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line:
“How can you call this victory?!
There are no winners here...!!”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “I still do not understand...”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line:
“However...
It may have been nice to see...”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “What?”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line:
“To see where you grew up...
I wonder how I would have...”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “Bartlett!!”

rows.Speaker: Emma
rows.Line: “Al! They just said on the news how our country beat that other country! That means you don't have to fight anymore...”

rows.Speaker: Emma
rows.Line: “Oh no...!”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“Bartlett!!
No... Why did it have to be like this...?”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “Why did I have to be the one to kill you...?”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“No, he's still alive...!
There should be a backup battery within his power core! As long that you didn't damage that...”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“I-It looks like it's gonna short...!
Do you have any tools I can borrow?!”

rows.Speaker: Emma
rows.Line:
“Yeah, we have some in the barn!
I'll go get them now!”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “I have no idea who you are, but please save him...! Please... I beg you...!!”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“Hang on...
Are you the other android? Did you and Bartlett come from the same laboratory?”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line:
“Y-Yes, that is correct...
I was found on this farm and have been working here for ten years now.”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “I see...”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “If Bart hadn't ended up with us, he might've been given a chance to lead a better life... Like you...”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “What...?”

rows.Speaker: Emma
rows.Line:
“I found the tools!
I really hope they help.”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“I'll try my best...!
But this is my first time doing this, so I can't guarantee anything...”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“There...!
We should be able to reboot him now...!”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “But I need to ask you something before I do...”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “If we allow him to reboot normally, he'll probably go straight back to being a weapon of war.”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “However, if we perform a full reset, we'd be able to erase all of his memories and give him another chance.”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “I want to erase all the horrible things we taught him. But as the one who was created alongside him, I need to know how you'd feel about that...”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “No, please do not reset him...”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “Turning him into a blank slate may be easier... But only he knows the value of everything that he experienced these past ten years.”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “So, please leave his memories intact.”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “Instead, would you mind installing this for me...?”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “Are these memories...?”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “They are mine. From these past ten years.”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line:
“I want Bartlett to see them.
I want him to see how beautiful this world is, and why I am able to feel.”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“Okay...
I'll install this before rebooting him.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This is your moment, Tsukasa...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Hold back as much as you can, and let just a little bit eke out...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Show us the never-before-seen moment where an android develops real, human emotions!)

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line:
“Where am I...?
I am seeing readings that my power core was destroyed...”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “Bartlett...!”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line:
“Alfred...
Did you wake me...?”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “Yes, he did.”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “I see...”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line:
“Alfred...
It appears that there is a mission that I must accomplish right now.”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “What?”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “Will you show me what I saw in these memories?”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “This beauty you saw over these past ten years?”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “Then... I may begin to understand who you are...”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line:
“Yes...
Yes, of course.”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “And... We can keep creating new memories together... Bart...”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “I would like that very much... Al...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I really do love these moments...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (When everybody takes my direction on board and their hard work blooms into a wonderful spectacle. Also...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (When I get to see that my direction has moved everyone's dreams along and made them smile...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I can't get enough of those moments...)
The next day

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you all very much for coming to see us!!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Thank you very much!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wow, we did it...!
We managed to make it through both days without incident!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
And the audience looked super happy!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
They really did.
Also, in comparison to our first performance, I think around double the people came to watch us.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: If anything, Tsukasa, we have you to thank for showing such tremendous growth!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: The final scene was as incredible as it was because you put so much effort into it.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: And it was so cool to watch! I guess that's Miles for you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, it's sad to think how this may be the last conversation we have together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The last one...?)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
I agree...
But this month was so much fun. So, thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you as well!
It was nice working with you!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start cleaning everything up.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Asahi...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After we finish cleaning up, can we talk?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
...!
Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, until then...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui...?
By the Fountain

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I apologize in advance for doing this right after our show. I'm sure you're very tired, Asahi...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
No, I'm okay.
I have triple the stamina of a normal person!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Anyway...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Have you reached a decision?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes...
By the Fountain

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After we spoke that day, I thoroughly weighed my options... To stay at Phoenix Wonderland as a member of Wonderlands×Showtime...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Or to work alongside you, Asahi, at ArcLand...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I thought quite a lot about each option in terms of making my dream come true...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be completely frank...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If I want to make my dream come true, I should accept your offer, Asahi.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The practices we held together for our performance showed me just how skilled and passionate the cast members of ArcLand are.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's a simple fact that no other place in Japan has such a group at its disposal.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not only that, but ArcLand provides the perfect working environment for directors. I wouldn't have to make any of my own props...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As a director, moving to ArcLand is what I should do...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That's quite an expression you've got on your face...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My expression? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
You know what I mean.
I wish there were a mirror here.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Rui...
Thank you for considering my offer. I'm glad you took the chance to join us seriously.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
But...
I have a feeling that your heart lies elsewhere.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Oh, I see...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I guess this means I...)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I noticed something when we were practicing together.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: The way you direct is truly egalitarian. You're never biased towards anyone.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That being said, you show a great amount of trust in everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: You still want to do shows with them, right...?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I wish things could've turned out differently...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Especially since it seems like I failed to make you think, “I want to direct for this guy!”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Which means I still have a long way to go as an actor.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's not true.
You're already an incredible actor, Asahi.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Haha. Thanks.
But I want to get better for when we meet next time and really make you do a double take.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Asahi...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Still, I understand how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I was blown away by Tsukasa's acting today. Compared to who I spoke to before the show, it's like he was a completely different person.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Nene and Emu also did an admirable job of keeping up with us.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: If I had friends like that, I'd want to do everything I can to make them shine on stage. I'd want to see how they grow moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes...
To me, Wonderlands×Showtime is...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A precious jewel that perpetually glows with color and brightness.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That's a nice expression.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll ask you again when you graduate from high school.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Until then, Rui, I'll be waiting. On the world's stage...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Asahi...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure you... No, I'm sure all of you will be able to catch up to me in no time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we will.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: In that case, let's both keep doing our best. For the sake of our friends!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, let's.
Museum of Emerging Technologies - Main Gate Plaza

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm back, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, there you two are!
Where have you been all this time?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We finished cleaning up what we were assigned to, so we decided to have a little chat. We apologize for disappearing like that partway through.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, it's our last day together, so it makes sense that you wanted to talk. Mind if I ask what the subject was?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, we talked a little bit about the future...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The future...?
That's awfully vague.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But this show did make me think a little about my own future.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It did?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I realized that my acting skills need a lot of work.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Getting to work with the cast members of ArcLand like this reminded me that the road to stardom is a long one.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, in order to become a world-class star that really shines, I'll need to learn as much as I can from actors like Asahi moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You as well, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
I'll be glad to help you, future star...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, now that our final ambassadorial performance has come to a close...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's start thinking about the next show we'll be doing at the Wonder Stage. I already have a mountain of ideas that I want you all to...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Nene, does this mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm not sure what happened...
But he seems a lot better now.
Aboard a Train

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe... I can eat lots more...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hnng... My shoulders feel...so heavy...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Sounds like they're having some nice dreams.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Rui, you're awake?
I thought you'd fallen asleep considering the day we had.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I had a few things on my mind is all. Aren't you going to sleep, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Actually, I've been thinking about a few things as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? May I ask what's on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The fact that we won't be putting on any more ambassadorial performances. It's been bothering me a little...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why's that...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As I mentioned a little while ago, this experience gave me an opportunity to learn quite a lot from Asahi and the others...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I suppose it's only natural for skill gaps to appear when performing in shows alongside good actors...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But learning something new topped all of that, and it ended up being very fun.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
I had fun as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can tell that you were able to learn several new things while working alongside Asahi this past month, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I knew it! You saying that means the changes I've been feeling are real!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, I'm saddened by how our ambassadorial performances are coming to an end. After all, we were able to meet and work with these incredible people because of them...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As a future star, I sure hope that I'll get more opportunities to really grow like this...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But there's no use crying over spilled milk!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We have a duty to fulfill as cast members of Phoenix Wonderland. Let us do what we can for it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Right...
Well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You have clear goals that you wish to accomplish, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You care deeply about doing your best as a cast member of Phoenix Wonderland and making your own dream come true...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. To be fair, I'm just paraphrasing what somebody else said.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But no one has the right to step on your true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
Hearing you say that is very encouraging.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And yes, you have a point...
For the sake of Phoenix Wonderland, as well as my own dream, it may be good to look at things that way moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yawn... I'm getting sleepy all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You should rest. I'm sure you're very tired after doing two performances today. I'll wake you when we arrive at our station.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, thank you.
Then, I'll be going to sleep for a bit...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...
*Snore*

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe.
What a lively snore.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa's also been thinking about what we'll be doing moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Sooner or later, we're all going to set out to achieve our own goals...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Things are fun now, but that may change in an instant.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I suspect I'll have moved on by the time that happens.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Or no...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Look at me. When am I going to grow a spine and learn to be more decisive...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, I did learn one thing from this experience...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I want to keep doing shows with my friends. More than I previously realized...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So, for now, I'll keep holding onto both...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (My desire to make my dream come true and my desire to keep putting on shows with my friends.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But it could be possible for us to stay together and make all our dreams come true... I'll try coming up with a way.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'm such a romantic...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I want to see that future.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So, I should do everything I can right now to make that happen...)
